description_en: Upgrades the version of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka upgrade-instance-version --instance-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --target-version 0.10.2 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeInstanceVersion

parameters.help_en:
The target open source version. Valid values:

- **0.10.2**

- **2.2.0**

If the value is the same as the current version, a minor version update will be triggered
parameters.help_zh:
目标开源版本。可取值为：

- **0.10.2**

- **2.2.0**

如果填写值为同版本，会触发升级到最新小版本
parameters.name: target_version

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id
